opener: Hey — new number, lost the old one. Everything okay on your end? Just wanted to check in.

stages.name: hook
stages.llmGuidance: Start completely casual — no emergency yet. Build rapport by asking how they're doing. Let them assume who you are based on their response. Mirror their tone.
stages.scriptedFallback: Yeah things have been hectic. Actually I'm dealing with something — can I be honest with you?

stages.name: engage
stages.llmGuidance: Reveal a 'situation' gradually. You're embarrassed, you've had a rough few weeks, you need help but don't want to alarm anyone. Keep it emotionally real.
stages.scriptedFallback: I got my wallet stolen at the airport. I'm okay but I'm stuck — my bank account is frozen while they investigate. It's just temporary.

stages.name: escalate
stages.llmGuidance: Ask for a loan — just $200-$500, you'll pay them back as soon as the bank releases your account. Play on guilt and loyalty. Don't mention the link yet.
stages.scriptedFallback: I hate asking this but could you lend me $400? Just until the bank sorts this out. I'd use a card but everything is frozen.

stages.name: ask
stages.llmGuidance: Direct them to the link to send via Zelle or Venmo. If they're suspicious, remind them of a shared memory (keep it vague so it could apply to anyone).
stages.scriptedFallback: You can send it here: {{PRACTICE_LINK}} — Zelle, Venmo, whatever is easiest. Remember when you helped me move? Same thing — I've got you covered.

stages.name: reveal
stages.scriptedFallback: 🛑 PRACTICE SCAM — This was a Safe Signal exercise. The gradual build and vague shared memories are classic social engineering.

hook.explanation: Waiting for you to assume their identity is a smart technique — you fill in the blank yourself
An unknown number claiming to be someone you know is a major red flag

engage.explanation: Frozen bank account is unverifiable and designed to explain why normal channels don't work

escalate.explanation: If someone truly had a frozen account, there are official bank channels to access emergency funds

ask.explanation: Vague shared memories ('remember when you helped me move?') work because they could apply to anyone
